summary: Even the base case underperforms the S&P; the stock is exposed to multiple compression and a 2027 refinancing.

findings.claim: A de-rating from 33x to 22x earnings alone would cut the price about a third even if guidance is met.

evidence.quote: we expect revenue growth of 8% to 10% and operating margin of 16% to 17%

findings.claim: $400 million of debt matures in fiscal 2027 and may be refinanced on worse terms.

evidence.quote: of which $400 million matures in fiscal 2027
